name: SYSTEM-H-V2-DEV-CANDIDATE

stage_2_local.L_semantics: total NEW local passages PER QUERY, not per parent
stage_2_local.term_statistics: full corpus - never recomputed inside routed documents

retrieval_prior.prior_form: piecewise channel assignment/substitution, not additive or multiplicative with E-L10. Existing E-L10 candidates keep their exact E-L10 retrieval_norm unchanged. Projection-only candidates receive min-max-normalized projection-RRF fused scores within that query's P=20 projection-only extras. No third RRF and no union-wide retrieval renormalization.

normalization.ce: min-max over the complete SYSTEM-G union pool, degenerate=0.5
normalization.retrieval: two independently normalized populations: original E-L10 retrieval_norm unchanged (degenerate=0.5); projection-only prior min-max over that query's P=20 projection-only extras (degenerate=0.5)

tie_breaks: E-L10 merge-RRF rank ASC (projection-only a_rank=1000000000, so E-L10 wins exact ties)

hash_scope: config_hash covers every field above including performance_path, following the precedent in systems.py where STAGE_2 carries exact_search/ann_index. score_determining_hash excludes performance_path only, because PERF-003 proved that path bitwise score-preserving; use it to ask whether two runs are comparable, not to identify the build.
description: V2 development architecture candidate: SYSTEM-G candidate generation + frozen CE blend + PERF-003 D1 performance path
